name: ATS/VMS Req Data
description: System of record for job requisitions; tracks open roles, timing, and fill status. Core DEMAND signal — how much hiring activity per SOC code and how hard each role is to fill. [DUMMY DATA]

name: Client Billing Data
description: Bill rate / pay rate / margin per placement. PRICE signal — compression can indicate commoditization (possible AI displacement); expansion can indicate scarcity/premium. [DUMMY DATA]

name: Candidate Pipeline Data
description: Submittals, interviews, and offers per req. SUPPLY signal — thin pipelines can reflect genuine scarcity or shrinking interest in a role. [DUMMY DATA]
